aabat.desc: An AA Battery, used over a wide array of consumer devices.
aabat.name: AA Battery

adrenal.desc: A sterile disposable syringe with a dose of adrenaline - the main hormone of the adrenal medulla. It is used to enhance the physiological response associated with the preparation of all muscles to increased activity. Temporarily boosts strength and endurance. Relieves the sensation of pain.
adrenal.name: Adrenaline injector

advconv.desc: A DC/DC converter that provides a regulated DC voltage. Using voltage converters makes it possible to eliminate malfunctions in the system. This converter has increased physical security and quality of components, which allows it to be used in highly loaded systems with increased physical impact factors.
advconv.name: Advanced current converter

afak.desc: AFAK (Adaptive First Aid Kit). A more advanced version of the IFAK individual first aid kit. The compact kit provides the individual soldier or law enforcement officer with a necessary lifesaving equipment to effectively treat injuries commonly associated with combat trauma.
afak.name: AFAK tactical individual first aid kit

ai2.desc: The AI-2 medkit was developed as a standard service first aid kit for various defense and law enforcement agencies and civil defense forces of USSR. In case of all-out conflict with the use of weapons of mass destruction it should have been distributed to the population of the affected and surrounding areas.
ai2.name: AI-2 medkit

alusplint.desc: An aluminum splint for fixing damaged bones in place.
alusplint.name: Aluminum splint

alyonka.desc: The famous milk chocolate of post-Soviet times, sweet and creamy.
alyonka.name: Alyonka chocolate bar

am_12buck.desc: A 12/70 buckshot shell for 12 gauge shotguns.
am_12buck.name: 12/70 7mm buckshot

am_545bp.name: 5.45x39mm BP gs

am_545ps.desc: A 5.45x39mm PS gs (GRAU Index - 7N6) cartridge with a 3.4 gram steel core bullet with lead cladding on the tip and a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. am_545ps.name: 5.45x39mm PS gs

am_762bp.desc: A 7.62x39mm BP gzh (GRAU Index - 7N23) cartridge with a 7.9 gram armor-piercing bullet with a hardened carbon steel core with lead cladding on the tip and a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. This BP bullet (Bronebóynaya Púlya - "Armor-piercing Bullet") was developed in the 1990s based on the 7.62x39mm PS gzh cartridge to improve it
am_762bp.name: 7.62x39mm BP gzh

am_762ps.desc: A 7.62x39mm PS gzh (GAU Index - 57-N-231) cartridge with a 7.9 gram bullet with a heat-strengthened steel core with lead cladding on the tip and a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. The PS cartridge (Púlya so Stal'ným serdéchnikom - "Bullet with a Steel core") was introduced into service in 1949 for Soviet 7.62x39mm caliber weaponry
am_762ps.name: 7.62x39mm PS gzh

am_762tt.desc: A 7.62x25mm Tokarev cartridge with a lead round nose (LRN) bullet; intended for sport shooting and hunting. am_762tt.name: 7.62x25mm TT LRN

am_9x18pst.desc: A 9x18mm Makarov Pst gzh (GAU Index - 57-N-181S-01) cartridge with a 5.9 gram steel core bullet with a lead cladding and a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. This cartridge was developed right after the adoption of the PM pistol with base on the 9x18mm PM P gzh cartridge to provide a more effective solution against hostile personnel
am_9x18pst.name: 9x18mm PM Pst gzh

am_9x19pst.desc: A 9x19mm Parabellum Pst gzh (RG057, GRAU Index - 7N21) cartridge with a 5.4 gram heat-strengthened steel core bullet with two-layer semi-jacket, a polyethylene interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a bimetallic case. This modified PS cartridge (Púlya Stal'náya - "Steel Bullet") was developed by TsNIITochMash in the early 1990s based on t
am_9x19pst.name: 9x19mm Pst gzh

ammocase.desc: The Kiba Arms International ammunition storage case.
ammocase.name: Ammunition case

analgin.desc: The cheapest and most widely available Metamizole painkillers.
analgin.name: Analgin painkillers

apollo.desc: Apollo Soyuz cigarettes. Inhaling those will potentially make you cough up to the stars in your eyes.
apollo.name: Apollo Soyuz cigarettes

ar_6b13.desc: The main armored vest for personnel of combat units of the ground forces, airborne troops, marines, etc. The vest is designed to protect vital organs from being hit by firearms, shell fragments, mines, grenades, and cold weapons, reducing the severity of armor contusion injury when performing combat missions. Flora camouflage version.
ar_6b13.name: 6B13 assault armor (Flora)

ar_6b23.desc: The "Zabralo-8" armored vest for personnel of combat units of the Russian ground forces, airborne troops, marines, etc. The vest is designed to protect vital organs from being hit by firearms, shell fragments, mines, grenades, and cold weapons, reducing the severity of blunt injury when performing combat missions.
ar_6b23.name: 6B23-1 body armor (EMR)

ar_iotv.desc: The Improved Outer Tactical Vest (IOTV) Gen IV is designed to permit maximum freedom of movement required to assume correct firing positions with the agility to execute and maneuver tasks. Optimal design characteristics ensure the best possible weight distribution of both the ballistic body armor system as well as additional load bearing
ar_iotv.name: IOTV Gen4 body armor (Full Protection Kit, MultiCam)

ar_module.desc: A lightweight bulletproof vest of class 2 of GOST-R protection, used by private security companies and collection services.
ar_module.name: BNTI Module-3M body armor

ar_paca.desc: A light but durable and reliable body armor protecting only the vital areas.
ar_paca.name: PACA Soft Armor

ar_zhuk.desc: An armored vest for journalists working in combat zones.
ar_zhuk.name: BNTI Zhuk body armor (Press)

bandage.desc: The most common gauze bandage, autoclaved and aseptic.
bandage.name: Aseptic bandage

beer.desc: Mmmmm... Pevko. The legendary drink of the streets of Tarkov.
beer.name: Bottle of Pevko Light beer

bitcoin.desc: A physical equivalent of the Bitcoin cryptocurrency (0.2 BTC value).
bitcoin.name: Physical Bitcoin

bleach.desc: The "Ox" special bleach and stain remover. The bleaching agent destroys chemical bonds, which is actively used in chemical production.
bleach.name: Ox bleach

bolts.desc: Bolts, together with screw nuts, are used to fasten things in place. An essential item for organizing a Hideout.
bolts.name: Bolts

bp_berkut.desc: A tactical backpack with front loading capabilities. Suitable for use by military and security forces, or for military tactical games. Manufactured in WARTECH.
bp_berkut.name: WARTECH Berkut BB-102 backpack (A-TACS FG)

bp_duffle.desc: A gym duffle bag, generally seen before with fitness enthusiasts or long-distance commuters, is now a typical Scav attribute.
bp_duffle.name: Duffle bag

bp_lbt.desc: A low-profile medical backpack, designed to carry large amounts of specialized medical equipment and supplies. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading.
bp_lbt.name: LBT-2670 Slim Field Med Pack (Black)

bp_mbss.desc: An extra durable backpack made from 1000D Cordura with a separate pocket for a water bladder and a MOLLE attachment system on the sides.
bp_mbss.name: Flyye MBSS backpack (UCP)

bp_pilgrim.desc: A large and brightly colored backpack that is perfect for the tourist on a raid.
bp_pilgrim.name: Pilgrim tourist backpack

bp_sanitar.desc: A medical bag, often used by mid and low rank medical personnel, sometimes by doctors, for carrying tools and medicine.
bp_sanitar.name: Sanitar's bag

bp_sling.desc: An original sling bag for everyday wear or for active rest.
bp_sling.name: Tactical sling bag (Khaki)

bp_transf.desc: A rather spacious messenger bag, large enough to fit a lunchbox, laptop and some papers - or a small emergency survival kit. Its transformable sling and universal size allow it to be worn both as bag and a compact backpack.
bp_transf.name: Transformer Bag

bp_vkbo.desc: Included in the all-season basic equipment kit (VKBO). Designed for transportation and storage of personal items of soldiers.
bp_vkbo.name: VKBO army bag

calok.desc: The CALOK-B applicator hemostatic agent allows you to inject hemostatic granules through a wound opening directly to the source of bleeding in just a few seconds.
calok.name: CALOK-B hemostatic applicator

caps.desc: Various electrical capacitors. Useful in electrical engineering.
caps.name: Capacitors

car.desc: Like a fire extinguisher, car first aid kit is crucially important protection measure in the event of an emergency on the road.
car.name: Car first aid kit

carbat.desc: Typical 12 V, 51 Ah lead-acid car batteries are in a big demand with traders, who resell them in the areas that have been left without power supply.
carbat.name: Car battery

cat.desc: An antique statuette of a cat, made of a rare sort of wood called Makassar Ebony.
cat.name: Cat figurine

cms.desc: Compact surgical kit for treatment of bullet wounds and other serious injuries.
cms.name: CMS surgical kit

cofdm.desc: A two-way speaking military COFDM wireless AV+data Signal Transmitter SG-C10.
cofdm.name: Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter

cyclon.desc: A special rechargeable battery for industrial and military devices.
cyclon.name: Cyclon rechargeable battery

dbat.desc: D (also R20, 373, Mono, UM) - one of the standard sizes for multipurpose batteries, used in the most energy-consuming portable electric devices like portable stereos, radiosets, GM counters, and powerful hand lights.
dbat.name: D Size battery

diary.desc: A diary with a leather cover. Covered with various names, addresses and phone numbers. Somebody might find it particularly useful.
diary.name: Slim diary

docscase.desc: A leather field case for document and map storage.
docscase.name: Documents case

drill.desc: A rare and old instrument, almost was out of use before the conflict. However, it's especially useful in current times.
drill.name: Hand drill

ducttape.desc: Duct tape is a universal tool to fix in one place something that moves, but shouldn't.
ducttape.name: Duct tape

edrill.desc: A cordless electric drill. Used in construction, furniture installation, and repair.
edrill.name: Electric drill

emelya.desc: Emelya rye croutons with assorted flavors were a favorite snack for kids and "cracking open a cold one while watching movies" enjoyers. Although, these days you won't find either the kids or any movies in Tarkov.
emelya.name: Emelya rye croutons

emotor.desc: A small electromechanical transducer, through which electrical energy is converted into mechanical energy. An indispensable thing in production or engineering.
emotor.name: Electric motor

esmarch.desc: The hemostatic tourniquet is named after Friedrich August von Esmarch, who proposed its use, along with other methods in military field surgery.
esmarch.name: Esmarch tourniquet

eur.desc: Several notes of the EU currency.
eur.name: Euros

ey_round.desc: Sunglasses with a round-shaped frame. Cool and stylish!
ey_round.name: Round frame sunglasses

ey_tactical.desc: A pair of commonplace tactical glasses with glare and impact protection.
ey_tactical.name: Tactical glasses

factorymap.desc: A simplified and updated copy of the Chemical Plant No. 16 facility blueprint.
factorymap.name: Factory plan map

fc_balaclava.desc: A definitive woolen balaclava is not only a head-warmer but soul-warmer too for anyone who is too modest for public heroic deeds.
fc_balaclava.name: Balaclava

fc_shroud.desc: An extremely stylish half mask with the Shroud logo. All the Tarkov street guys know who he is.
fc_shroud.name: Shroud half-mask

ffgps.desc: A configurable low noise GPS amplifier module with pre-filtering and wide input voltage range.
ffgps.name: Far-forward GPS Signal Amplifier Unit

flashdrive.desc: A secure flash drive. Such USB sticks are frequently used by TerraGroup employees. They can definitely contain sensitive data.
flashdrive.name: Secure Flash drive

fleece.desc: An insulated lightweight water-repellent fabric for the production of various clothes, both military and civilian.
fleece.name: Fleece fabric

g_f1.desc: The F-1 hand grenade (GRAU Index 57-G-721) is an anti-personnel fragmentation defensive grenade, designed for neutralizing enemy personnel in defensive combat. Due to a significantly effective fragmentation radius, it should only be thrown from behind hard cover, such as a concrete wall, APC, or tank.
g_f1.name: F-1 hand grenade

g_m67.desc: M67 Fragmentation Hand Grenade is an American hand grenade, designed for antipersonnel combat purposes and adopted in 1969 by the army of the United States.
g_m67.name: M67 hand grenade

g_rgd5.desc: RGD-5 (GAU index - 57-G-717) is an antipersonnel fragmentation time-delayed offensive hand grenade. The grenade's UZRGM fuze insures a time delay of 3.2 - 4.2 seconds. Due to the offensive type of the grenade, its fragments are relatively light and have a smaller dispersion radius.
g_rgd5.name: RGD-5 hand grenade

g_zarya.desc: Intended to suppress the mental stability by creating a sudden sound effect and a bright flash. Used in special operations for apprehension of criminals and in riot suppression.
g_zarya.name: Zarya stun grenade

gasan.desc: A measuring device for determining the qualitative and quantitative composition of gas mixtures. It has a very wide range of applications - in environmental protection, internal combustion engines management systems, and medicine.
gasan.name: Gas analyzer

goldchain.desc: A golden neck chain is bound to be a rather profitable piece of jewelry to find.
goldchain.name: Golden neck chain

goldegg.desc: A golden egg with a "Meyer" engraving.
goldegg.name: Golden egg

goldphone.desc: A golden GPhone 1G Edition Orange Gold smarthphone. There is a small 1G logo on the back side.
goldphone.name: Golden 1GPhone smartphone

goldstar.desc: The famous Vietnamese "Golden Star" balm, also known as Cao Sao Vang, is made from essential oils like Camphor, Menthol, Peppermint, Cajuput, all mixed into vaseline. A small amount of the balm is applied to the sub-district and rubbing of the skin: for headache - the temples and the nape of the neck, with a cold - under the nostrils, the
goldstar.name: Golden Star balm

gphone.desc: The last thing that Wepple managed to release on the smartphone market. Broken and unusable, but contains a lot of useful components.
gphone.name: Broken GPhone X smartphone

gpu.desc: A graphics card is just as good a source of electronic components as anything else - fans, CPUs, IC, etc.
gpu.name: Graphics card

greenbat.desc: 3.7 volt battery with a nominal capacity of 3400 mAh. Used in lighting and engineering devices.
greenbat.name: GreenBat lithium battery

grenadecase.desc: A large case for storing various hand grenades.
grenadecase.name: Grenade case

grizzly.desc: Sportsman Series Grizzly Medical Kit is considered one of the best first aid kits. It contains everything necessary to provide immediate medical care in extreme conditions.
grizzly.name: Grizzly medical kit

hddbroken.desc: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Serves as the main data drive in most computers. Hardware specialists use broken disks to salvage the controllers and magnets for re-use in other electronics.
hddbroken.name: Damaged hard drive

hl_6b47.desc: 6B47 is an aramid helmet of Russian origin. As part of the Ratnik program, it is the new standard-issue helmet for most of the Russian Armed Forces. The 6B47 is similar to previous generation helmets such as the 6B7-1M and 6B27. It has equal protection but weighs slightly less, floats in water, and has mounting equipment for lights and ni
hl_6b47.name: 6B47 Ratnik-BSh helmet (EMR cover)

hl_fast.desc: The Ops-Core FAST Maritime ballistic helmet is popular in special forces all around the world. Can be modified with different components. Black version.
hl_fast.name: Ops-Core FAST MT Super High Cut helmet (Black)

hl_kolpak.desc: Kolpak-1S protects the head from the cold piercing-cutting weapons in a special class of protection GOST R50744-95, from fragmentation with an energy of impact up to 50 J, and also serves to reduce the dynamic loads arising from the above-mentioned means of destruction. Kolpak-1 protective helmets are recommended by the Interdepartmental
hl_kolpak.name: Kolpak-1S riot helmet

hl_lshz.desc: A lightweight protective helmet made in Russia. Basically a cheap copy of Ops-Core FAST helmet with lower characteristics.
hl_lshz.name: LShZ lightweight helmet (Olive Drab)

hl_ssh68.desc: SSh-68 replaced the general-army SSh-60 helmet. It differs from its predecessor in greater durability, a large inclination of the front part, and short side boards.
hl_ssh68.name: SSh-68 steel helmet (Olive Drab)

hl_ushanka.desc: The Ushanka ear flap hat is a classic hat worn by Russian people, or that is at least what most people from the west seem to believe.
hl_ushanka.name: Ushanka ear flap hat

horse.desc: A horrendously kitsch horse figurine is useless in Tarkov - just as anywhere else - but somewhere out there, there are dealers still willing to buy such things. Something is not right about this.
horse.name: Horse figurine

hose.desc: Corrugated hose for use in gardens. Could be useful for organizing a Hideout.
hose.name: Corrugated hose

hotrod.desc: Hot Rod, though being the most recognizable energy drink in the world, is not much more powerful than its counterparts. The standards are the same for all.
hotrod.name: Can of Hot Rod energy drink

hs_comtac.desc: The ComTac II amplifies low-level sounds while suppressing impulse noises. Water resistant for outdoor usage. Manufactured by Peltor.
hs_comtac.name: Peltor ComTac II headset (OD Green)

hs_gssh.desc: The GSSh-01 headset is used in the Russian Ratnik military gear set.
hs_gssh.name: GSSh-01 active headset

hs_rac.desc: A component for the Ops-Core FAST helmet - a system of noise reduction and amplification of quiet sounds, as well as a radio headset when connected to the communication device.
hs_rac.name: Ops-Core FAST RAC Headset

ibuprofen.desc: Ibuprofen is a medication in the nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) class that is used for treating pain, fever, and inflammation.
ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen painkillers

ifak.desc: IFAK is a personal medical kit issued to soldiers in service. The official first aid kit in the U.S. Marine Corps IFAK (Individual First Aid Kit of the United States Marine Corps). The latest, third-generation (gen3), the most well-designed and rich in contents.
ifak.name: IFAK individual first aid kit

injcase.desc: A case for storing injectors, stimulants, and other specialized medications.
injcase.name: Injector case

insultape.desc: Although insulating tape is primarily intended for insulation of wires, its practical application is limited only by the creativity of its owner. Most typical cases include minor maintenance, holding together split parts, binding some stuff together and anti-slip wrapping of handles.
insultape.name: Insulating tape

intel.desc: A folder with various documents that can be very useful and valuable to third parties.
intel.name: Intelligence folder

iskra.desc: The compact package of a field ration includes everything you need for a comfortable nutrition of an adult person in the most difficult conditions.
iskra.name: Iskra ration pack

itemcase.desc: A storage case for various items.
itemcase.name: Item case

junkbox.desc: A large storage case for all sorts of different items and goods that you may or may not need for later barters.
junkbox.name: Lucky Scav Junk box

k_bunk.desc: A key to one of the portable cabins that was being used as a bunkhouse, located somewhere in the Customs construction area.
k_bunk.name: Portable bunkhouse key

k_factexit.desc: A somewhat fragile factory emergency exit door key.
k_factexit.name: Factory emergency exit key

k_gasoffice.desc: A key to the director's office room inside one of the gas stations.
k_gasoffice.name: Gas station office key

k_gassafe.desc: A key to the safe inside the gas station, located somewhere near the Azure Coast sanatorium.
k_gassafe.name: Gas station safe key

k_gasstore.desc: A key to the storage room inside one of the gas stations.
k_gasstore.name: Gas station storage room key

k_machine.desc: A key to special machinery such as tank trucks, tractors, road-building machinery, etc.
k_machine.name: Machinery key

k_marked.desc: A mysterious key to an unknown door at the abandoned city factory. There is a strange symbol scratched onto it.
k_marked.name: Abandoned factory marked key

k_pump.desc: An old soviet factory key labeled "Pumping Station".
k_pump.name: Pumping station back door key

lcd.desc: Intact and working liquid crystal display. It can be used in surveillance systems as a signal visualization device.
lcd.name: Working LCD

ledx.desc: A medical device designed to accurately determine the position of the veins under the skin.
ledx.name: LEDX Skin Transilluminator

lion.desc: A collectible bronze lion figure. The thing is heavy, seemingly beautiful. Useful either for sale or aesthetic pleasure.
lion.name: Bronze lion figurine

m_axe.desc: An antique axe with a damaged handle that belonged to the ancient clan of hatchlings called WYCC.
m_axe.name: Antique axe

m_bayonet.desc: The so-called "Item 6Kh5" is a bayonet knife adopted in 1989 as a standard-issue for use with AK-74 assault rifles.
m_bayonet.name: 6Kh5 Bayonet

m_crash.desc: Designed as a tool for working with hard surfaces. Materials and construction are designed to provide optimal impact and strength. The head of the axe is made of 6AL4V titanium with a thickness of 2.85 inches.
m_crash.name: Crash Axe

mag_ak74.desc: A 30-round 5.45x39 6L20 Izhmash bakelite magazine, for AK-74 and compatible systems.
mag_ak74.name: AK-74 5.45x39 6L20 30-round magazine

mag_akm.desc: A 30-round 6L10 magazine made with an AG-4S moulding compound, for 7.62x39 AK and compatible weapons. Can also be supplied with .366 TKM ammo for use with the corresponding caliber AK-compatible weapons.
mag_akm.name: AK 7.62x39 6L10 bakelite 30-round magazine

mag_kedr.desc: A standard 20-round capacity metal magazine for PP-91 Kedr-based 9x18PM SMGs, manufactured by ZMZ.
mag_kedr.name: PP-91 Kedr 9x18PM 20-round magazine

mag_pm.desc: A standard 8-round magazine for IzhMekh-produced Makarov PM pistols. It features a side observation slot for checking the magazine capacity.
mag_pm.name: PM 9x18PM 90-93 8-round magazine

magcase.desc: A wheeled weapon magazine storage case.
magcase.name: Magazine case

malboro.desc: Malboro Cigarettes are a big hit with the wealthier part of the local smoking populace.
malboro.name: Malboro Cigarettes

medcase.desc: A storage container for medical items.
medcase.name: Medicine case

milboard.desc: Electronic part used in military vehicles and systems.
milboard.name: Military circuit board

milfilter.desc: A military power filter used in armored vehicles.
milfilter.name: Military power filter

milk.desc: Condensed milk, also called "Sguschyonka" in Russia, once was a part of field ration for the Union soldiers in Civil War, but later reached unprecedented popularity in post-Soviet countries, becoming almost a staple product. Canned, it can be stored for decades and remain just as sweet, tasty and nutritious.
milk.name: Can of condensed milk

moneycase.desc: The TARBank armored money storage case.
moneycase.name: Money case

morphine.desc: A single-use syringe full of morphine. A powerful drug, used primarily to treat both acute and chronic severe pain.
morphine.name: Morphine injector

mre.desc: MRE (Meal, Ready-to-Eat) is an individual daily food ration developed for the United States Army. MRE packaging is designed for harsh operating conditions and protection from weather exposure, which allows not to worry about storage conditions. Contains a lot of different products to quench your hunger in the field conditions.
mre.name: MRE ration pack

nails.desc: A package of construction nails. In conditions of continuing crisis they are used for construction of temporary shelters, bunkhouses, and other assembly.
nails.name: Pack of nails

nuts.desc: Just a handful of commonplace screw nuts, with no apparent use. An essential item for organizing a Hideout.
nuts.name: Screw nuts

oatflakes.desc: Package of oat flakes, primary component of healthy porridge for breakfast.
oatflakes.name: Pack of oat flakes

paracord.desc: A lightweight polymeric cord made of nylon, originally used in parachute slings. Paracord can be used for many other purposes, both military and civilian.
paracord.name: Paracord

pcb.desc: A universal component in microelectronics. An essential resource for maintaining electronic systems.
pcb.name: Printed circuit board

phased.desc: High-tech part of the phased array antenna used in radiolocation systems and radio-electronic warfare systems.
phased.name: Phased array element

pineapple.desc: "Russian Army" reconstituted pineapple juice. It's hard to imagine a better source of carbs and vitamins under blockade conditions.
pineapple.name: Pack of Russian Army pineapple juice

pliers.desc: A high-quality tool for capturing, manipulating, and cutting wire.
pliers.name: Pliers Elite

powercord.desc: An electrical 220v power cable for Personal Computers.
powercord.name: Power cord

prokill.desc: A chain with the Prokill medallion. An attribute of the Contract Wars, and now - a relic.
prokill.name: Chain with Prokill medallion

propital.desc: A military-issue stimulant permitted to only be used by medical officers and paramedics. It stimulates regeneration processes by increasing the biosynthesis of purine and pyrimidine bases, RNA, functional, and enzymatic cell elements. Increases metabolism, health, and vitality. Has continuous side effects.
propital.name: Propital regenerative stimulant injector

raven.desc: A raven figurine made out of rare materials. The word "Markstrom" is engraved on the base.
raven.name: Raven figurine

rechbat.desc: A chemical source of electric current, reusable source of voltage, characterized by the reversibility of internal chemical processes that ensures its repeated cyclic use (via charge-discharge) for energy accumulation and autonomous power supply of various electrical devices and equipment, as well as providing backup power sources in medic
rechbat.name: Rechargeable battery

rfid.desc: A high-performance UHF RFID fixed reader. Based on proprietary efficient digital signal processing algorithm, it supports fast tag read/write operation with high identification rate. It can be widely applied in many RFID application systems such as logistics, access control, anti-counterfeit and industrial production process control syste
rfid.name: UHF RFID Reader

rig_ana.desc: The M2 vest is created with the use of the best experience of Russian special forces operators. The versatility of the system makes it possible to use this vest both when carrying out urban tasks and when performing tasks on rough terrain. Equipped with additional pouches for 8 magazines. Manufactured by ANA Tactical.
rig_ana.name: ANA Tactical M2 plate carrier (EMR)

rig_blackrock.desc: A custom-made chest rig for wearing on top of body armor in urban operations. Sturdy and versatile, it features both MOLLE and ALICE attachment systems.
rig_blackrock.name: BlackRock chest rig (Gray)

rig_csa.desc: The simplest chest rig, sewn hastily from dubious materials. Designed for airsoft. Military use of this model is possible, but not recommended.
rig_csa.name: CSA chest rig (Black)

rig_idea.desc: A handcrafted chest rig made from IDEA store bags. It's impossible to say that it's reliable and suitable for a wide range of military and tactical applications, but at least it's a good example of a hobo-style rig.
rig_idea.name: DIY IDEA chest rig

rig_lbt.desc: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading.
rig_lbt.name: LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (MAS Grey)

rig_scav.desc: A fisherman's vest can more or less replace the chest rig, if the need is pressing enough.
rig_scav.name: Scav Vest

rig_wartech.desc: This chest rig platform is designed for placing equipment in the chest and abdomen areas, with an open back. Includes integrated pouches, designed for 8 magazines. Can be used both separately and on top of the armor vest. Manufactured by WARTECH.
rig_wartech.name: WARTECH MK3 TV-104 chest rig (MultiCam)

ripstop.desc: Ripstop fabrics are woven fabrics, often made of nylon, using a special reinforcing technique that makes them resistant to tearing and ripping. Used for special and military cloth and gear production.
ripstop.name: Ripstop fabric

rolex.desc: A gold watch of the famous Roler brand. The case is made of 18 karats yellow gold.
rolex.name: Roler Submariner gold wrist watch

rooster.desc: A golden rooster on an acrylic platform with an engraved "ChickenPrism" logo.
rooster.name: Golden rooster figurine

rub.desc: A few notes of the still-valued Russian rouble.
rub.name: Roubles

salewa.desc: A first aid kit containing a bivibag, various types of bandages, and dressing tools.
salewa.name: Salewa first aid kit

sc_alpha.desc: A small secure container used by PMCs formerly deployed in Tarkov.
sc_alpha.name: Secure container Alpha

sc_beta.desc: A medium-sized secure container used by PMCs formerly deployed in Tarkov.
sc_beta.name: Secure container Beta

sc_epsilon.desc: One of TerraGroup's latest inventions in secure container technology - the Epsilon secured container.
sc_epsilon.name: Secure container Epsilon

sc_gamma.desc: A unique secure container used only by veteran PMCs formerly deployed in Tarkov.
sc_gamma.name: Secure container Gamma

sc_kappa.desc: A secret TerraGroup invention - the Kappa secured container.
sc_kappa.name: Secure container Kappa

screws.desc: A self-tapping screw is a fastening product in the form of a rod with a head and a special external thread that forms an internal thread in the hole of the object to be connected. Used for the installation of wooden, plasterboard, and plastic panels.
screws.name: Pack of screws

skullring.desc: A ring in the shape of a skull, a real attribute of a goon who has reached success.
skullring.name: Gold skull ring

splint.desc: A common splint for fixing damaged bones in place.
splint.name: Immobilizing splint

sten140.desc: Tank battery with increased capacity. Milspec electronics.
sten140.name: 6-STEN-140-M military battery

stewL.desc: A large amount of canned beef stew, commonly referred to as "tushonka", can be stored for years, thus rivaling condensed milk in importance as a food supply for both military and tourists.
stewL.name: Can of beef stew (Large)

stewS.desc: A small amount of canned beef stew, commonly referred to as "tushonka", can be stored for years, thus rivaling condensed milk in importance as a food supply for both military and tourists.
stewS.name: Can of beef stew (Small)

strike.desc: Strike Cigarettes can be sold off to traders for their personal use later.
strike.name: Strike Cigarettes

surv12.desc: An advanced surgical kit with additional high-quality tools, allowing treating serious injuries right on the battlefield.
surv12.name: Surv12 field surgical kit

teapot.desc: An item from a rare collection of antique silver tea service set.
teapot.name: Antique teapot

tetriz.desc: An ancient artifact of a lost past. May be of interest to Mechanic, an avid collector of electronics.
tetriz.name: Tetriz portable game console

toolset.desc: A repairman’s bag with a set of different tools.
toolset.name: Toolset

vase.desc: A porcelain vase from a private collection. In theory, can serve as a beer pitcher.
vase.name: Antique vase

vaseline.desc: Vaseline, or, more precisely, petroleum jelly, is a versatile ointment used for a number of purposes where its water insulation and lubrication properties are required, for instance, for treating small cuts and burns, coating corrosion-prone items or lubricating gear that requires non-acidic lubricants.
vaseline.name: Vaseline balm

virtex.desc: A specialized programmable military processor. The product is focused on high-latency broadband applications that require processing a large amount of data and minimal latency.
virtex.name: Virtex programmable processor

vita.desc: Multifruit and multivitamin juice can be confusing tastewise, but it sure is healthy.
vita.name: Pack of Vita juice

vodka.desc: "Tarkov fire water". It is not recommended to consume it in general, alcohol is harmful and all that, but sometimes it is necessary to relax after the battle. No need to raid area 51 to see them aliens after all.
vodka.name: Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka

w_ak74n.desc: AK-74N (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Night") was developed in 1970 by M. T. Kalashnikov, became a further evolution of AKM due to adoption of the new 5.45x39 ammunition by the military. The key design difference from the standard AK-74 is a side mount for optical and night scopes.
w_ak74n.name: Kalashnikov AK-74N 5.45x39 assault rifle

w_akm.desc: The AKM (Avtomát Kaláshnikova Modernizírovanny - Kalashnikov's Automatic Rifle Modernised) 7.62x39mm automatic rifle was adopted in 1959 to replace AK as a standard service weapon of the Soviet Army. Main differences compared to AK: enhanced accuracy range, lower weight, new stock, trigger, hammer retarder, muzzle compensator, and other d
w_akm.name: Kalashnikov AKM 7.62x39 assault rifle

w_aks74u.desc: AKS-74U (Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoy 74 Ukorochenny - "Kalashnikov's Shortened Automatic rifle 74 with a foldable stock") is a shortened version of the AKS-74 assault rifle, developed in the early 80s for combat vehicle crews and airborne troops, also became very popular with law enforcement and special forces for its compact size.
w_aks74u.name: Kalashnikov AKS-74U 5.45x39 assault rifle

w_kedr.desc: The PP-91 Kedr is a submachine gun chambered in 9x18 PM, designed by Yevgeny Dragunov in the early 90s by order of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and produced at ZMZ (Zlatoústovskiy Mashinostroítelnyy Zavód - "Zlatoust Machine-Building Plant"). This submachine gun has a simple but effective design. Its light weight makes it more comfort
w_kedr.name: PP-91 Kedr 9x18PM submachine gun

w_kedrb.desc: A rare silenced version of the PP-91 Kedr submachine gun, denominated as PP-91-01 Kedr-B.
w_kedrb.name: PP-91-01 Kedr-B 9x18PM submachine gun

w_mp133.desc: The MP-133 is a multi-shot pump-action shotgun produced by IzhMekh. It is the evolution of the earlier IZh-81 pump-action shotgun and is intended primarily for civilian and security markets.
w_mp133.name: MP-133 12ga pump-action shotgun

w_mp153.desc: The MP-153 smoothbore multi-shot shotgun, manufactured by IzhMekh ("Izhevsky Mechanical Plant"). A reliable and practical hunting and self-defense weapon.
w_mp153.name: MP-153 12ga semi-automatic shotgun

w_pb.desc: The PB pistol (Pistolét Besshúmnyy - "Silenced Pistol", GRAU Index - 6P9) was designed with a two-part suppressor, the main suppressor and a section built into the barrel, which allows the weapon to be operated without problems even without the main suppressor attached, but operating the weapon in this way will not mitigate the sound or m
w_pb.name: PB 9x18PM silenced pistol

w_pm.desc: The time-proven PM pistol (Pistolét Makárova - "Makarov Pistol", GAU Index - 56-A-125). Due to the ubiquitous spread of both the pistol and its ammunition, as well as its exceptional reliability, light weight, and compact size, the PM still sees wide service in both police, military, and security forces. Although the damage makes you wish
w_pm.name: Makarov PM 9x18PM pistol

w_saiga.desc: A semi-automatic 12-gauge shotgun with a folding stock, equipped with a firing mechanism safety lock that only allows firing from extended stock position. Features a short 430mm barrel.
w_saiga.name: Saiga-12K ver.10 12ga semi-automatic shotgun

w_tt.desc: A legendary pistol that has seen numerous military conflicts throughout the years and is still in service in certain regions of the world, in one variation or another. This one is a classic TT-33, the most mass-produced version. It features a Browning short-recoil tilting-barrel system, but other than that, the construction design is very
w_tt.name: TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol

w_vpo136.desc: The Molot Vepr-KM/VPO-136 carbine is based on the well-known Kalashnikov AKM and has an almost identical appearance, weight, and overall dimensions. Designed for hunting of medium and big game, as well as for sporting use.
w_vpo136.name: Molot Arms VPO-136 Vepr-KM 7.62x39 carbine

wallet.desc: A simple wallet for storing money.
wallet.name: Simple wallet

water.desc: A 0.6 liter bottle of water. The bottle itself might be a bit dirty, but the water is clean. Hopefully.
water.name: Bottle of water (0.6L)

wd40.desc: Initially, this agent was developed for industrial consumers as an anti-corrosive water repellent. It was later discovered that it also had plenty of domestic use applications. According to the legend, the product's formula was developed on the fortieth attempt (WD-40 as short for Water Displacement - 40th Attempt). The product consists m
wd40.name: WD-40 (100ml)

wilston.desc: The image of a typical street punk would not be complete without Wilston cigarettes.
wilston.name: Wilston cigarettes

wirebundle.desc: Pieces of various purpose wires. Might be usable for electronic purposes.
wirebundle.name: Bundle of wires

wrench.desc: A twin-head wrench. Despite the simplicity of design, the wrench is used in almost all areas of technology to build mechanisms of various levels of difficulty.
wrench.name: Wrench

zagustin.desc: A military-issue drug. Inhibits activators of profibrinolysin and slows down its transformation in fibrinolysin. Temporarily stops the bleeding and increases resistance to bloodloss. Has side effects. Leads to severe dehydration.
zagustin.name: Zagustin hemostatic drug injector
